subtitle.noise: Unusual sounds like clicking, grinding, rattling, or squealing
subtitle.vibration: Unusual shaking you can feel in the handlebars, seat, or pegs
subtitle.leak: Fluid dripping or pooling under the bike — oil, coolant, or fuel
subtitle.smoke: Visible smoke or steam from the exhaust, engine, or other areas
subtitle.warningLight: A warning indicator lit up on your dashboard
subtitle.performanceIssue: The bike feels less powerful, sluggish, or doesn't respond normally
subtitle.visualDamage: Visible cracks, dents, rust, or wear you can see
subtitle.smell: Unusual burning, fuel, or chemical odors
subtitle.engine: The main motor that powers the bike
subtitle.brakes: Front or rear brake pads, rotors, calipers, or lines
subtitle.exhaust: The pipes and muffler that carry exhaust gases away
subtitle.tires: The rubber tires, wheels, or rims
subtitle.electrical: Battery, lights, starter, wiring, or electronics
subtitle.suspension: The forks, shocks, or how the bike handles bumps
subtitle.chainDrivetrain: The chain, sprockets, belt, or shaft that drives the rear wheel
subtitle.bodywork: Fairings, fenders, tank, seat, or frame
subtitle.always: The issue is constant, no matter what you're doing
subtitle.atSpeed: Only when riding at higher speeds
subtitle.idle: When the engine is running but the bike isn't moving
subtitle.coldStart: When you first start the bike after it's been sitting
subtitle.hotEngine: After riding for a while when the engine is warm
subtitle.braking: When you apply the front or rear brake
subtitle.acceleration: When you twist the throttle to speed up
subtitle.turning: When leaning or turning the handlebars
subtitle.clicking: A rhythmic tick or click, often from the engine or drivetrain
subtitle.backfiring: Loud pops or bangs from the exhaust
subtitle.squealing: A high-pitched screech, often from brakes or belts
subtitle.wobble: The handlebars or frame shaking side to side
subtitle.hardToSteer: The bike feels heavy or resists turning
subtitle.spongyBrakes: The brake lever feels soft or goes too far before engaging
subtitle.rustCorrosion: Orange-brown buildup or pitting on metal surfaces
subtitle.discoloration: Parts changing color from heat, fluid, or chemical damage
subtitle.wontStart: The engine won't turn over or fire up
subtitle.stalling: The engine dies unexpectedly while running
subtitle.poorFuelEconomy: Using more fuel than usual for the same riding
subtitle.overheating: Temperature gauge reads high or you see steam

support.faq1Question: How do I add a motorcycle?
support.faq1Answer: Go to the Garage tab and tap the + button. You can search for your motorcycle by make, model, and year.
support.faq2Answer: Describe your motorcycle symptoms in the Diagnose tab. Our AI analyzes common issues and provides likely causes with recommended actions.
support.faq3Answer: Yes! You can add as many motorcycles as you want. Set one as your primary bike for personalized recommendations.
support.faq4Question: How do I change my language?
support.faq4Answer: Go to Profile → App settings → Language and pick the language you want.
support.faq5Answer: Yes. We use end-to-end encryption and follow industry best practices. You can export or delete your data at any time from Privacy settings.

v3220.overviewDesc: Every bike now opens on an Overview: what needs attention, what’s due next, what you’ve spent, plus your notes and papers. Service, Costs and Bike are one tap away in the bar at the top.
v3220.notesDesc: Keep part numbers, tire pressures and shop details with the bike they belong to. Add a photo to a note, search your notes later, or turn one into a task.
v3220.logDesc: Tap Log on a bike to add an expense, a task, work you’ve already done, a note or a document. Updating the odometer now uses a keypad on iPhone and Android alike.

v380.analyticsDesc: Total distance, riding time and personal bests — all updating after every ride. Your stats, at a glance.
v380.redesignedRidesDesc: Every ride screen rebuilt from scratch — map banners, record badges, cleaner detail views, and a smoother save flow.
v380.flyoverDesc: Replay any ride as a cinematic satellite flyover with terrain, elevation, and smooth camera animation.
v380.shareDesc: Generate beautiful visual cards of your rides and share them anywhere — Instagram, WhatsApp, or save to your gallery.
v380.widgetsDesc: Next service, expenses, last ride, and weekly stats — right on your home screen and Lock Screen. No need to open the app.

v360.onboardingDesc: A smoother start — animated experience picker, goal-driven personalization, and real fleet data.
v360.maintenanceDesc: Swipe through OEM tasks to build your bike's maintenance plan during setup. Accept what matters, skip the rest.
v360.bikeSetupDesc: See real rider stats, service intervals, and a welcome message when you add your bike.

v300.redesignDesc: A warm editorial look across every screen. Cleaner, faster, and built for the road.
v300.rideRecordingDesc: GPS filtering removes drift and noise so your routes are razor-sharp.
v300.liveStatsDesc: See speed, distance, elevation, and moving time updating in real time as you ride.
v300.tripPlannerDesc: Plan multi-day rides with drag-and-drop waypoints, AI suggestions, and offline maps.

v250.groupRidesDesc: Organize group rides with live meeting points and rider counts. Your crew, your roads.
v250.routeReviewsDesc: Score routes on twisties, scenery, and surface quality. Find the roads worth riding.
v250.commentsDesc: Drop warnings about road hazards, recommend pit stops, and help the riding community.
v250.tripsDesc: Map multi-stop rides with waypoints. Share your itinerary with riding buddies.

v3110.vaultDesc: Insurance, registration, title, service records — keep every important paper for each bike in one private, secure place. Snap a photo or import a PDF in seconds.
v3110.remindersDesc: Add an expiry date and we'll remind you 30, 7, and 1 day before — so your insurance or registration never lapses again.

v3191.receiptTitle: Scan a Receipt, Skip the Typing
v3191.receiptDesc: Point your camera at a fuel, parts, or service receipt — MotoVault reads the amount, date, and vendor and fills in the expense for you. Check it, save it, done.
v3191.carplayDesc: Log rides from your bike’s screen. Start, pause, and finish a ride on the head unit without touching your phone — or let Automatic mode start it on the first GPS fix.

v3250.plateDesc: Home and Garage now show each bike on a plate. One look tells you whether it’s ready to ride, has service coming up, or is overdue.
v3250.themeDesc: Every screen now has a light and a dark look and follows your Theme setting. Pick one in Profile › App settings › Theme, or leave it on System to match your phone.
v3250.profileDesc: Profile is split into clearer sections, and language, theme, units and currency now live together in App settings. Setting up a new account is smoother too.

startRide.subtitle: Pick a bike and roll out. GPS, speed, and route will be tracked until you tap end.
startRide.trackingNote: Tracks GPS, speed and route until you tap end.
startRide.resolveUnfinished: Resolve the unfinished ride above to start a new one
startRide.locationMessage: MotoVault needs location access to record your ride. Please enable it in Settings.
startRide.startError: Failed to start ride. Please try again.
startRide.disclosureBody: MotoVault records your route, distance, and speed while you ride — including in the background when the app is closed or your screen is off, so your whole ride is captured. Location is only used while a ride is active.
startRide.disclosureSettingsNote: You may be taken to Settings — choose “Allow all the time” to keep recording in the background.
startRide.approximateBody: With approximate location, MotoVault can't record your route or distance. Turn on Precise Location for MotoVault in Settings.

rideHud.gpsLostBody: Location permission was turned off, so your ride is no longer recording. Tap to fix it or end the ride.

rideHud.reminderFinalBody: No movement for {{minutes}} minutes. End the ride to save it as it was when you stopped.
rideHud.autoEndedBody: You hadn't moved for {{minutes}} minutes, so we ended your ride and saved it up to where you stopped.
rideHud.serviceBody: Tap to return to your ride. End it when you get off the bike.
rideHud.noGpsBody: {{minutes}} min recorded, but almost no distance. GPS may have been blocked, switched off or set to approximate location.

hub.title: CarPlay Companion
hub.intro: Log rides from your bike’s screen. Controls live on the head unit — the phone just confirms.
hub.modeAutoDesc: Rides start themselves on first GPS fix and pause at long stops. Nothing to tap.
hub.modeManualDesc: Nothing logs until you press Start Ride on the head unit. Full control, zero surprises.
hub.modePhoneFirstDesc: Start on the phone, hand off to CarPlay when you connect. For pre-ride setup.

cues.title: Confirmation cues
cues.intro: How a silent auto-start tells you it began. Both on by default — they cover each other.
cues.audioSub: Ducks nav voice ~0.5s · plays on lock
cues.caution: With both off, auto-start is silent. You won't know a ride began until you glance at the tile.
cues.mechanicalDesc: Mechanical — a rugged, brand-true click. Default.

onboarding.c1Body: Distance, climb and moving time live on your motorcycle’s display — glance, never tap.
onboarding.c2Body: MotoVault never takes the map. Your nav app keeps showing turns — the toggle flips to MotoVault for a glance, then back.
onboarding.c3Body: Change it anytime in the companion. You can always tell what’s about to happen.

bikePick.title: Which bike is this for?
bikePick.subtitle: Pick the bike this receipt belongs to.

consent.title: Scan a receipt with AI
consent.body: We send a photo of your receipt to our AI to read the amount, date and details — so you don’t have to type them. The photo is stored privately on your account and never shared. You can always enter details by hand instead.

capture.title: Photograph the receipt
capture.subtitle: Lay it flat, fill the frame, and keep the total in view.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: We saved your receipt and we’ll finish reading it automatically as soon as you’re back online. No credit is used until it’s processed.

error.extractionFailedBody: The photo was too blurry or the text was unclear. You can enter the details by hand instead.
error.imageInvalidBody: We couldn’t use that image. Try taking the photo again, or enter the details by hand.
error.quotaExceededTitle: You’ve used all your free scans
error.quotaExceededBody: Upgrade for unlimited receipt scans, or enter this one by hand. Your photo is saved.
error.disabledBody: Receipt scanning is paused right now. You can still enter this receipt by hand.
error.alreadyCompletedBody: It finished processing just before you skipped. You’ll find it waiting in your receipts to review.
error.uploadFailedBody: We couldn’t upload your receipt. Check your connection and try again.
error.analyzeFailedBody: We couldn’t finish reading your receipt. Try again — if it already went through, you’ll find it waiting in your receipts to review.
error.rateLimitedBody: You've scanned a lot today. Please try again tomorrow, or enter this receipt by hand.

parked.title: Saved for later
parked.body: Your receipt is ready to review. We’ll remind you tomorrow, and it’s waiting on your home screen.

alreadyProcessed.title: Already processed
alreadyProcessed.body: This scan finished before it could be cancelled. You can review it now or find it later in your receipts.
